title: Trash
hint: Deleted sessions and projects stay here until you delete them permanently. Nothing is removed from disk before that.
remote: Deleting permanently is only possible on the machine itself. From a remote desktop you can restore.

empty.title: The Trash is empty
empty.hint: Sessions and projects you delete land here, and can be restored until you delete them permanently.

confirm.emptyMessage: Delete everything in the Trash permanently? {sessions} and {projects} will be lost. This cannot be undone.
confirm.restoreWithProjectMessage: Project "{name}" is in the Trash too. Restoring this session restores the project as well, with its sessions that were not deleted on their own.
